description: Cairnflow — operations dashboard. Every metric comes from a node's /metrics; what has no metric yet points at an admin endpoint.

panels.title: Nodes scraped
panels.description: Number of instances answering /metrics (one target per node).

panels.title: Ranges in the table
panels.description: cairnflow_partitions — the number of ranges in the current range table.

panels.title: Ranges without a leader
panels.description: max(cairnflow_partitions) − min(cairnflow_partitions_with_leader). Non-zero for more than 2 minutes fires the CairnflowRangesWithoutLeader alert.

panels.title: Range table version
panels.description: cairnflow_range_table_version — changes on every split/merge (and every intent write/removal).

panels.title: Nodes draining
panels.description: sum(cairnflow_draining) — slow nodes yielding their leadership.

panels.title: Deployment
panels.description: cairnflow_deployments — deployments in the node's registry (max across nodes).

panels.title: Durable commit wait (p50/p99)
panels.description: cairnflow_commit_wait_seconds: a turn waiting for the WAL flush tick (Lease::sync meeting a write that is not durable yet). External acks only go out after this wait (D11), so this is the commit part of the ack latency.

panels.title: Durable waits / s
panels.description: cairnflow_durable_waits_total — the number of times a turn actually waited for a WAL flush tick.

panels.title: Object store PUT p99 by kind
panels.description: cairnflow_object_put_seconds{kind} — session renewal (session) and shared WAL PUT (wal). Input to the slow score.

panels.title: Ingress calls by outcome / s
panels.description: cairnflow_invoke_*_total — outcomes as seen by the node's ingress.

panels.title: Cancellations and background ticks / s
panels.description: cairnflow_cancelled_total, cairnflow_admin_ticks_total, cairnflow_admin_tick_advanced_total.

panels.title: One invocation run (p50/p99)
panels.description: cairnflow_drive_seconds — from getting a slot until it stops, including every SDK turn of that run.

panels.title: Turns sent to SDKs / s
panels.description: cairnflow_sdk_*_total. Non-zero rr_turns on a cluster that should be all BIDI means some deployment declares REQUEST_RESPONSE.

panels.title: Timer firing lateness p99
panels.description: cairnflow_timer_lateness_seconds (target ≤ 20 ms).

panels.title: Slots granted / s and mean slot wait
panels.description: cairnflow_flow_granted_total; mean wait = rate(cairnflow_flow_wait_ms_total) / rate(cairnflow_flow_granted_total).

panels.title: Turns blocked by resource / s
panels.description: cairnflow_flow_blocked_total{resource=lock|concurrency|turns}. Who blocks whom: GET /vqueues.

panels.title: Turn time by range (top 10)
panels.description: cairnflow_range_turn_ms_total{range} — turn seconds per second of each range, printed by the range's leader. Input to split suggestions with reason load.

panels.title: Retries that met a busy invocation / s
panels.description: cairnflow_flow_retry_busy_total — a steady rise with the tick is the sign of a retry storm.

panels.title: Slow log / s
panels.description: cairnflow_slow_log_total (printed), cairnflow_slow_log_dropped_total (over the 10 lines/s cap).

panels.title: Healthy follower readers
panels.description: cairnflow_reader_healthy{range}: 1 healthy, 0 wedged. Only present when the node opened a reader.

panels.title: Ingress 429s by reason / s
panels.description: throttled = cairnflow_invoke_throttled_total (slot wait limit exceeded: concurrency or rate — not split yet, see docs/runbooks/README.md 'Missing metrics'); range_overloaded = cairnflow_range_l0_shed_total{kind="ingress"} (L0 throttle, no invocation created).

panels.title: Work deferred without a 429 / s
panels.description: cairnflow_flow_throttled_total: turns (background ones included) dropped because the slot wait limit ran out, rescheduled. cairnflow_range_l0_shed_total{kind=inbound|dispatch}: StartCall from another range / local child call deferred by the L0 throttle.

panels.title: L0 views by range
panels.description: cairnflow_range_l0_views{range}, cap 8 (l0_max_ssts). Soft throttling starts at --l0-soft (default 5).

panels.title: L0 throttle level by range
panels.description: cairnflow_range_l0_reject_ratio{range}: the probability of refusing new work (0 = no throttling, at most --l0-max-reject).

panels.title: Work throttled by L0 / s
panels.description: cairnflow_range_l0_shed_total{range,kind}.

panels.title: SlateDB L0 SSTs
panels.description: cairnflow_range_slatedb_l0_ssts{range}.

panels.title: SlateDB stall / backpressure / s
panels.description: cairnflow_range_slatedb_l0_stalls_total (the flusher refused because L0 hit its cap), cairnflow_range_slatedb_backpressure_total (writes waiting because of max_unflushed_bytes).

panels.title: Write stalls (s per s)
panels.description: cairnflow_range_write_stall_seconds_total / cairnflow_range_write_stalls_total — db.write waits ≥ 10 ms.

panels.title: Shared WAL GC floor age by node
panels.description: cairnflow_nodewal_floor_age_seconds{node}: how long the floor has been stuck at a pinned object. At ≥ 600 s the node logs a warn and the CairnflowNodeWalFloorStuck alert fires.

panels.title: Ranges pinning the floor
panels.description: cairnflow_nodewal_floor_pinned{range} = 1: the range has not flushed its frame to L0. Lines only exist while some range pins.

panels.title: Slow score by node
panels.description: cairnflow_slow_score: 1 (healthy) to 100 (slow), 10 s rounds. Yields at 100 for two rounds in a row with a p99 PUT > 2× the other nodes' median.

panels.title: draining by node
panels.description: cairnflow_draining: 1 while the node is yielding its leadership because it is slow.

panels.title: PUT session p99 by node
panels.description: cairnflow_object_put_seconds{kind="session"} — the main signal of the slow score.

panels.title: Auto splits done / failed
panels.description: increase(cairnflow_auto_split_total), increase(cairnflow_auto_split_failed_total) — a failure after the intent has been rolled back.

targets.legendFormat: failed, rolled back (in the time range)

panels.title: Range table changes
panels.description: changes(cairnflow_range_table_version[5m]) — split/merge (manual or automatic) and intents.

options.content:
Split suggestions **have no metric yet** on main. Look at them with:

```
GET /ranges/suggestions?scope=cluster
```

Fields `reason` (`load`/`size`/`hot_owner`) and `blockedBy` (`cooldown`, `node_rate`, `intent`, `upgrading`, `l0`, `busy`/`conflict`/`failed`). Load per range: `GET /ranges/stats?scope=cluster`.

Proposed metrics: `docs/runbooks/README.md` section *Missing metrics*.

The D-d pass (`--gc-retired-dbs`) **exports no metric yet** on main. Look at it with:

```
GET /admin/gc/plan
GET /admin/gc/barriers
```

`eligible` = ranges that can be deleted; `blocked[].by` = `barrier` · `age` · `reference` · `upgrading`. From outside the cluster: `cairn-ctl ranges retired`.

Runbook: `docs/runbooks/gc-and-barriers.md`.

The cluster version and the `upgrading` lock **export no metric yet** on main. Look at them with:

```
GET /admin/cluster-version
```

`upgrading` other than `null` = a node is running a cluster-level migration (split/merge return 503, GC skips its turn, auto split is blocked with `upgrading`). After an upgrade: `version` = `binary.knows`, and every `nodes[].knows` is equal.

Runbook: `docs/runbooks/upgrade-and-rollback.md`.

panels.title: Schedule fires by outcome
panels.description: cairnflow_schedule_fires_total: fired (a run was created), skipped (overlap skip — the previous run has not finished), missed (missed fire times folded into one fire: a dead node or a tick slower than several fire times), throttled (L0 throttle, fires again later). A steady rise of missed means the leader cannot keep up with the tick.

panels.title: Schedule fire lag (p50/p99)
panels.description: cairnflow_schedule_fire_lag_seconds: from the fire time (jitter included) to the commit of the fire. The background tick is 1 s by default; much longer means the range's tick loop is blocked.

panels.title: Schedules
panels.description: cairnflow_schedules: schedules of the ranges each node holds (counted on becoming leader, adjusted on PUT/DELETE).

panels.title: Replay REQUEST_RESPONSE / s
panels.description: cairnflow_rr_replay_total{result} (wire v5, incremental replay): hit = delta, the SDK could join it; miss = the SDK missed ⇒ full resend; full = no hint; disabled = turned off on the node or by the deployment itself. A lasting high miss rate ⇒ an endpoint with many replicas and no affinity.

panels.title: RR replay bytes saved / s
panels.description: cairnflow_rr_replay_saved_bytes_total: replay bytes not sent to the SDK thanks to delta hits (before compression), next to the bytes actually sent (cairnflow_sdk_bytes_total).

panels.title: RR journal size p50/p99
panels.description: cairnflow_rr_journal_bytes (histogram): replay bytes per REQUEST_RESPONSE turn. Above 10 MiB the node logs a warn once per invocation — suggesting ctx.artifact.

panels.title: API responses by status class / s
panels.description: cairnflow_http_responses_total: every response of the public API by status class. 503 means "retry": not the leader, the range is changing, store_unavailable. Alert CairnflowHttp5xxRate.

panels.title: Ack latency p50/p99
panels.description: cairnflow_ack_seconds{route="send"}: from receipt to the 2xx of POST …/send — the invocation is durable. Alert CairnflowAckLatencyHigh.

panels.title: Store requests / s
panels.description: cairnflow_store_requests_total by operation: put, list, copy are class A; get, head class B. Alert CairnflowStoreRequestRateHigh.

panels.title: Node RAM
panels.description: cairnflow_process_resident_bytes against cairnflow_memory_limit_bytes (the cgroup limit, otherwise the whole machine). Alert CairnflowMemoryHigh at 85%.

panels.title: Free disk
panels.description: cairnflow_disk_free_bytes / cairnflow_disk_total_bytes by directory (data, disk_cache). Alert CairnflowDiskLow below 10%.
